entities.summary: Egyptian New Kingdom, a political institution in Israel during Canaanite and Bronze Age Levant (1550 BCE–1200 BCE). Grew from Development of the proto-Sinaitic/Canaanite alphabet — ancestor of all alphabets and Megiddo and Hazor emerge as major Canaanite city-states. Led to the emergence of Egyptian Domination and Amarna Period.
